--version.help: Prints the version of the program and quits.

--help.help: Prints this help message and quits.

--size.help: Sets the size of the partition in pages (256 bytes each).

--charset.help: Sets the charset to use for encoding file names.

--max-inodes.help: Sets the maximum number of inodes. Total size of the inode table is max-inodes * 12 bytes.

--min-folder-size.help: Sets the minimum size of a folder's data block in bytes.

--readonly.help: Sets the FS to be read-only.

--stdout.help: Prints the FS to stdout instead of writing it to a file.

--pack.help: Packs the given source directory into a LNFS filesystem.

--unpack.help: Unpacks the FS from a file instead of creating it.
